coordinate_convention: left/right refers to the existing masterplan image unless a geographic direction is explicitly verified

evidence_levels.alumni_confirmed: confirmed by the project owner / alumnus and treated as a hard spatial constraint until contradicted by stronger same-period evidence
evidence_levels.photo_verified: verified by dated or otherwise attributable imagery
evidence_levels.pending: requires further period-photo, drawing, measurement, or alumnus verification

constraints.statement: The detached toilet block is on the image-left side of the main teaching building and is directly connected to it.
The basketball area contains six courts in a 3 by 2 arrangement.
The six-court basketball block and the adjacent running track are parallel and directly abut one another. No road, green buffer, or unrelated building may be inserted between their boundaries.

A strip / cluster of sports auxiliary rooms lies on the image-left side of the running track beside the basketball area. Its remembered functions include fitness / exercise equipment, the PE teachers' office, and storage for sports equipment. Exact room subdivisions, doors, windows, and dimensions remain pending.

The music classroom is beside the running track and behind the gymnasium. It is a separate building / room group from the sports auxiliary rooms and must not be merged with them in the masterplan or 3D model.
The basketball / pool-area toilet is on the image-left side of the swimming pool.
The athletics-field rostrum is on the image-left side of the field.
A sandpit exists near the flag area.
A school-name stone stands to the right side of the gate in the reference view.

sports_zone_acceptance: Court block and adjacent running track share a direct boundary and remain parallel.
Sports auxiliary rooms are present on the image-left side of that running track.
Fitness / exercise, PE office, and sports-equipment-storage functions are represented as separate identifiable program areas once room-level evidence is available.
Music classroom remains beside the track and behind the gymnasium but is not merged with the sports auxiliary rooms.
Any exact dimension or room subdivision without evidence is marked pending rather than invented.
